predictions.rationale: Implements the graph model specific to Use Case diagrams, managing nodes (actors, use cases) and their relationships—core to feature.
Main class representing a Use Case diagram in the UI; central for creating and managing the diagram.
Responsible for visual rendering of Use Case diagrams, mapping model elements (actors, use cases) to figures on the canvas.
Graphical figure class for individual Use Case elements, a primary component of Use Case diagrams.
Graphical figure class representing actors, the other main component of Use Case diagrams.
Provides helper operations for Use Case model elements, facilitating creation and manipulation of use cases and related constructs.
Factory class for constructing Use Case–related model elements (use cases, actors, includes, extends), directly supporting the feature.
Figure for the «extend» relationship between use cases, an important relationship visualized in Use Case diagrams.
Figure for the «include» relationship in Use Case diagrams, providing visual representation of included scenarios.
Initialization class that registers and sets up Use Case diagram components within the application.
